content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-step-step-7|COREMERCH guide to setting]] up a sovereign digital store is a four-step sequence that most creators overcomplicate by starting in the wrong order. Step one is the backend: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-8|Cloudflare Workers]]-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-6|cloudflare]] Workers or Google Apps Script handles payment verification, order logging, and product delivery. Step two is the payment layer: NOWPayments connects your wallet addresses to the checkout flow — no KYC required from you or your buyer. Step three is the storefront: Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages serves your store for free with no server management. Step four is testing: complete a real mainnet transaction, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Only after step four passes cleanly should you promote the store. COREMERCH deploys the complete Edge Stack — Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments — in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH is a game-changer for digital creators in Zimbabwe. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, this stack provides a robust and scalable foundation for online stores. With NOWPayments handling crypto transactions, creators can finally accept payments without relying on restrictive platforms. This infrastructure is built to last, with a focus on sovereignty and control.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, you'll need to prepare a few essential components. First, ensure you have a Cloudflare account and a basic understanding of how Pages and Workers function. You'll also need to set up a Supabase instance for storing orders and customer data. Finally, create a NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions. With these pieces in place, you're ready to start building your store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With your infrastructure components ready, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. Configure your NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments, and integrate it with your Cloudflare Pages store. Use Cloudflare Workers to handle payment webhooks and automate order fulfillment. For digital product delivery, use Cloudflare's R2 storage or Google Drive. This streamlined pipeline ensures seamless transactions and instant product delivery.
Build a crypto store with Cloudflare Pages.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. Test your payment pipeline thoroughly to ensure everything is working as expected. With your store live, you can start promoting your products and accepting crypto payments from customers worldwide. Monitor your store's performance, and be prepared to scale your infrastructure as your business grows.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your crypto store grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to meet increasing demand. Cloudflare Pages and Workers provide a solid foundation for scaling, while Supabase handles growing order volumes. Monitor your store's performance, and adjust your infrastructure accordingly. With the right scaling strategy, you can ensure your store remains fast, reliable, and secure, even as your business expands globally.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Accept crypto payments with NOWPayments.

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH is a powerful solution for digital creators, providing a robust infrastructure for online stores. By leveraging this stack, creators can focus on growing their business, rather than worrying about payment restrictions or infrastructure limitations.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
